facts.fact: The ICT ministry's Permanent Secretary writes that Chief Administrative Officers, Town Clerks, district commercial officers, community development officers and parish chiefs are among the officials given access to the national Parish Development Model information system (PDMIS), which holds over 8 million household records and tracks UGX 2.7 trillion of disbursements; she does not say how their offices are connected, and gives no date, so the article's is used.

systems.country_label: Parish-Based Management Information System / Parish Development Model Information System (PDMIS)
systems.platform: built under the National ICT Initiatives Support Program (NIISP); verifies NINs against the NIRA database
systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
systems.tiers: national ministries, district Chief Administrative Officers, Town Clerks, district commercial officers, community development officers, SACCO executives and parish chiefs; over 8 million household records, nearly 79% of households

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, through the Ministry of Local Government
systems.tiers: Chief Administrative Officers and Town Clerks

systems.country_label: 24,434 tablets previously used for census data collection
